title: Administrator
description:
Administrator

Location: Maidstone

Salary: 24,800

Hours: Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm. Hybrid working offered - opportunity to work from home 3 days per week.

We are currently seeking an Administrator to join a friendly, supportive team.

What you'll be doing:
- Resolve routine enquiries or escalate complex issues
- Respond to email queries
- Maintain accurate customer records and documentation
- Support daily administrative tasks and team workflows
- Liaise with internal departments when required

What they're looking for:
- Strong communication and customer service skills
- Good administrative ability and attention to detail
- Confidence using multiple systems and working in a process-driven environment
- A proactive approach with the ability to multitask and prioritise

If you're organised, customer-focused, and looking for your next opportunity, we'd love to hear from you!

Apply today with your CV or contact us for more information!

Huntress Search Ltd acts as a Recruitment Agency in relation to all Permanent roles and as a Recruitment Business in relation to all Temporary roles.

We practice a diverse and inclusive recruitment process that ensures equal opportunity for all we work with, irrespective of race, sexual orientation, mental or physical disability, age or gender. As an organisation, we encourage applications from all backgrounds and will ensure measures are met when required, to allow a fair process throughout.

PLEASE NOTE: We can only consider applications from candidates who have the right to work in the UK.

title: Receptionist
company: Kent and Medway Mental Health NHS Trust
advertiser_name: Kent and Medway Mental Health NHS Trust
description: Priority House in Maidstone is seeking a professional, welcoming part-time Receptionist to join our dedicated team. This is a vital, office-based role operating our main reception and switchboard, often working independently. As the first point of contact for our busy site, you will interact daily with patients, relatives, visitors, and staff, ensuring everyone receives a warm, high-quality service while keeping our administrative operations running smoothly. Shift Pattern 28.5 hours per week on a set rota: Monday, Wednesday & Friday: 13:00 - 21:00 Every other weekend (Saturday & Sunday): 07:00 - 13:00 Front of House & Switchboard: Provide a courteous reception service for all patients, visitors, and colleagues. Efficiently manage the central switchboard by handling high-volume incoming calls and transferring them to the correct departments. Daily Administrative Support: Process outgoing franking mail, sort incoming letters into local department pigeonholes, and assist the Site Admin and Site Supervisor with routine tasks. Information & Safety Maintenance: Update on-call doctor contact details and site security logs daily. Maintain accurate telephone directories across all departments and report any operational issues promptly. Facilities & Equipment Coordination: Monitor key office equipment (photocopiers, shredders) to ensure smooth operation, performing basic troubleshooting or arranging engineer call-outs as required. Team Collaboration & Compliance: Provide short-term cover for colleagues during annual leave or sickness. Maintain health and safety within your working area and strictly adhere to all Trust policies and procedures Please refer to the attached job description for the full details on the responsibilities and person specification
